audit_method: Read all 23 section report and corresponding available machine evidence; retain evidence hashes and declared source revisions.
Count all 938 frozen command nodes, 535 shortcuts, 251 metadata methods and 25 compiled event keys.
Reconcile explicit fixture/mapping identities with frozen catalog; this verifies coverage indexing, not runtime effect semantics.
Inspect retained source files and 61 build expressions without rebuilding registrations; current shared changes await coordinator signal.
Do not sum historical reruns as unique tests or treat blocked/skipped/live-dependent cases as passes.
audit_scope: Read-only active working-tree audit; revision identifies the base commit and per-file SHA-256 binds observed evidence. Concurrent later edits require a new gate, not inferred acceptance.

brand.feishu_lark: Frozen variants retain the full contracts; Apps is Feishu-only, present but guarded on Lark. Current dynamic comparison pending.

notes: Archive fixture coverage of 14 combinations is not 14 real cross-builds or native platform runtime evidence.
Darwin/arm64 host evidence cannot certify Linux/Windows/macOS amd64 runtime.
Frozen 61 explicit build expressions all checked individually; implicit filename platform selection remains in source list.

findings.detail: 17 methods across approval 14 / attendance 1 / mindnotes 2 were assigned foundation by P0 annotation fallback and lacked P2 domain acceptance. Root assigned a new business owner; 25 nodes retained in supplement.
Active shared helper changes, new Sheets/Base commands and intentional flags require final actual next-surface comparison plus hash-bound review. Source retention is not current behavioral parity.
Every domain live guarantee and P2 comparative evaluation remains unverified/open except explicitly scoped historical P1 setup evidence. All 23 sections remain open for full acceptance.
Packaging archive fixtures and cross-compilation do not establish native OS behavior. Seven platform pairs and two CLI variants require separately labeled evidence.
